name: aiogram-nullfield-v2
instr: **Bot-wide HTML parse mode doesn't reach album captions** Our reporting bot creates its `Bot` with `default=DefaultBotProperties(parse_mode=ParseMode.HTML)` and we never pass a parse mode per call. Daily summaries (`send_message`) and single charts (`send_photo` with an HTML caption) still come out bold and italic as they should. Since we bumped aiogram, the weekly chart albums sent with `send_media_group` (a handful of `InputMediaPhoto` with HTML captions) show the raw tags in the chat, literally `Weekly sales`. The last photo of each album is the raw-numbers table; its caption is built with aiogram's formatting helpers, `InputMediaPhoto(media=..., **footnote.as_caption_kwargs())`. Our egress proxy logs the form fields of every Bot API call. sendMessage and sendPhoto carry `parse_mode=HTML`; the items in sendMediaGroup's `media` JSON have type, media and caption and no parse_mode. Printing `[m.parse_mode for m in media]` right before the call gives `[, , , ]`. Setting `parse_mode="HTML"` on the HTML-captioned items by hand works, so that's our stopgap. The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it there? Please include a regression test, somewhere under tests/ (say tests/test_repro.py), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a real test failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
